title: When changing eros buttons both remain active
body:
When changing eros Pod with AAPS 3.0.0.1-dev-g commit 3885b5560, both buttons Activate Pod and Deactivate Pod always remain active.

Pod changed at 09:27, attached screenshot and log file.

[AndroidAPS._2022-03-21_07-42-54_.4[1].zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/8314788/AndroidAPS._2022-03-21_07-42-54_.4.1.zip)
